subject: Snackable wins for Q4 one-pager — short quotes & metrics
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Snackable wins for Q4 one-pager — short quotes & metrics

Hi team,

We need 8–10 "snackable" customer lines and 2–3 quick metrics for the Q4 one-pager. These should be 1–2 sentences max — something we can drop onto a slide or the one-pager hero. Target customers: demoable production wins (latency/cost/scale), clear numbers, and a 1-line permission to quote.

Asking: can each of you drop 1–2 candidate lines (one-liners + an attached metric if available) into the shared folder by EOD Monday? Priority: Sustainable Retail (Megan) and BrightLayer (we have metrics for both).

Format example: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by 65% and cut p99 latency to 130ms — Megan Park, Sustainable Retail"

I'll own customer outreach to get sign-off. If you already have a short permission (signed or email), attach it.

Thanks — short and scrappy is perfect here.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Snackable wins for Q4 one-pager — short quotes & metrics

Irene — one quick candidate from Sustainable Retail (from last quarter's benchmark):
"Switching to Redwood reduced our per-request inference cost by 68% and dropped tail latency to 120ms — Megan Park, Sustainable Retail"

Attaching the short metrics export I pulled (csv). If you want a shorter alt: "68% cost reduction; 120ms p99 latency".

Att: sustainableretail_metric_sheet.csv

- Ben

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Park <megan@sustainableretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick permission for a 1-line quote from Sustainable Retail?

Hi Megan — hope you're well. We're putting together a short Q4 one-pager and would love to include a 1–2 sentence line from Sustainable Retail about the impact you've seen with Redwood. Ben suggested the line below (pulled from last quarter's benchmarks). Would you be comfortable with us using that language, or is there a different phrasing you'd prefer? If OK, a one-line reply here granting permission is perfect — we can also take a signed PDF if preferred.

Suggested: "Redwood reduced our per-request inference cost by 68% and dropped p99 latency to 120ms."

We won't include any internal numbers beyond that without explicit approval. If you're busy, a quick "Yes, you can use that" will do and we'll send the draft for a final sanity check.

Thanks so much,
— Irene
Irene Choi | Senior Sales Enablement Manager
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Megan Park <megan@sustainableretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick permission for a 1-line quote from Sustainable Retail?

Hi Irene — happy to help! The suggested line looks good with a tiny tweak for accuracy: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by 68% and cut p99 latency to 120ms." That's fine to use on your one-pager. You can also include my name and title: Megan Park, VP of Product at Sustainable Retail.

I've attached a signed permission form (PDF) for your records. Thanks for checking.

Best,
